mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE up AS ( SELECT id AS child, id AS anc FROM entity_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} UNION SELECT up.child, p.parent_id FROM up JOIN entity_type_parents p ON p.child_id = up.anc ), closure AS (SELECT child, array_agg(anc) AS ancs FROM up GROUP BY child), doc AS ( SELECT lower(string_agg(text, ' ' ORDER BY seq)) AS text FROM chunks WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND superseded_at IS NULL ), sources AS ( SELECT src.fact_id, src.statement_id FROM typed_fact_sources src JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = src.statement_id AND fe.document_id = #{documentId} UNION SELECT i.fact_id, i.statement_id FROM implied_fact_sources i JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = i.statement_id AND fe.document_id = #{documentId} WHERE i.statement_id IS NOT NULL ), typed AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fact_id) fact_id, statement_id FROM sources ORDER BY fact_id, statement_id) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.id AS fact_id, ty.statement_id, t.predicate_id, t.subject_id, t.recorded_at, s.canonical_name AS subject, st.key AS subject_class, r.key AS property, r.label AS property_label, t.object_id, COALESCE(o.canonical_name, t.object_value #>> '{value}', t.object_value::text, '') AS object, ot.key AS object_class, CASE WHEN s.type_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_domains d WHERE d.relation_type_id = r.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_domains d WHERE d.relation_type_id = r.id AND d.entity_type_id = ANY(sc.ancs)) THEN 'domain' WHEN o.type_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_ranges g WHERE g.relation_type_id = r.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_type_ranges g WHERE g.relation_type_id = r.id AND g.entity_type_id = ANY(oc.ancs)) THEN 'range' WHEN r.datatype = 'date' AND t.object_id IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE((t.object_value #>> '{value}') ~ '^\d{4}(-\d{2}(-\d{2})?)?', false) THEN 'no_date' WHEN position(lower(s.canonical_name) IN doc.text) = 0 OR (o.id IS NOT NULL AND position(lower(o.canonical_name) IN doc.text) = 0) THEN 'name_absent' END AS flag, (SELECT fe.quote FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = t.id AND fe.document_id = #{documentId} AND fe.quote IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fe.chunk_id LIMIT 1) AS quote FROM typed ty JOIN facts t ON t.id = ty.fact_id JOIN entities s ON s.id = t.subject_id LEFT JOIN entity_types st ON st.id = s.type_id LEFT JOIN closure sc ON sc.child = s.type_id JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = t.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = t.object_id LEFT JOIN entity_types ot ON ot.id = o.type_id LEFT JOIN closure oc ON oc.child = o.type_id CROSS JOIN doc WHERE t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.layer = 'typed' AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errata_actions ea WHERE ea.fact_id = t.id) ) c ORDER BY (c.flag IS NULL), c.recorded_at, c.fact_id

SELECT d.id FROM documents d WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN (SELECT fact_id, statement_id FROM typed_fact_sources UNION ALL SELECT fact_id, statement_id FROM implied_fact_sources WHERE statement_id IS NOT NULL) src ON src.statement_id = fe.fact_id JOIN facts t ON t.id = src.fact_id WHERE fe.document_id = d.id AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errata_actions ea WHERE ea.fact_id = t.id)) OR (d.graph_status = 'done' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errata_runs r WHERE r.document_id = d.id))) ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM errata_runs WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errata_runs (id, kb_id, document_id, flagged, sampled) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{documentId}, #{flagged}, #{sampled})
mapper.update: UPDATE errata_runs SET requests = #{requests}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, kind FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND key = #{key}
SELECT kind FROM relation_types WHERE id = #{predicateId}
SELECT object_id, object_value FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}
SELECT valid_from IS NOT NULL AND valid_to IS NOT DISTINCT FROM valid_from FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}
SELECT valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_from_grade, valid_to, valid_to_precision, attested_from FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}
SELECT doc_time FROM documents WHERE id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errata_actions (id, kb_id, run_id, document_id, fact_id, statement_id, predicate_id, flag, action, reason, quote, proposed, status, detail) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{runId}, #{documentId}, #{factId}, #{statementId}, #{predicateId}, #{flag}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{quote}, #{proposed,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{detail})
mapper.update: UPDATE errata_actions SET new_fact_id = #{newFactId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fact_evidence (fact_id, chunk_id, quote, document_id, doc_version) SELECT #{factId}, c.id, #{quote}, c.document_id, c.doc_version FROM chunks c WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.superseded_at IS NULL
AND position(lower(#{quote}) IN lower(c.text)) > 0
ORDER BY c.seq LIMIT 1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT action, fact_id, document_id, proposed, quote FROM errata_actions WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'held'
mapper.update: UPDATE errata_actions SET status = #{status}, new_fact_id = #{newFactId}, decided_by = #{actor}, decided_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'held'
mapper.select: SELECT ea.id, ea.document_id, d.filename AS document, ea.action, ea.flag, ea.fact_id, ea.proposed, ea.reason, ea.quote, ea.detail, ea.created_at FROM errata_actions ea JOIN documents d ON d.id = ea.document_id WHERE ea.kb_id = #{kbId} AND ea.status = 'held' ORDER BY ea.created_at, ea.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*), min(created_at) FROM errata_actions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'held'
